description: Python script for loading, augmenting, padding, and formatting gesture sensor data for training machine learning models, specifically using TensorFlow.

classes.name: DataLoader
classes.description: Class for loading, processing, and formatting gesture sensor data for training.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes DataLoader with data paths and sequence length, loads data from files.

methods.name: get_data_file
methods.description: Reads data and labels from a JSON lines file, optionally augments training data.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Applies neighbour padding to data sequences with added noise.

methods.name: format_support_func
methods.description: Formats data and labels into padded tensors and creates TensorFlow datasets.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats all datasets (train, validation, test) with padding and returns TensorFlow datasets.
